## 1. Site Information

> **Severity:** 🟢 NO CONSTRAINT

**Property Location:** 1700 S Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78704 (1401 and 1509 Collier St)
**Total Site Area:** 5.2127 acres (227,064 SF) per TCAD; 5.211 acres per ALTA survey [TCAD]

The site is controlled by a single owner and is proposed for mixed-use multifamily development with ground-floor retail, targeting 90 ft height via the DB90 density bonus program.

## 4. Zoning

> **Severity:** 🟡 MODERATE CONSTRAINT -- DB90 limited to Tract 1 only; CO setback on Tracts 2 & 3

### Zoning by Tract [COA GIS]

**Tract 1 -- CS-V-DB90** (General Commercial Services -- Vertical Mixed Use -- Density Bonus 90)
- Coverage: 99.5% of parcel (148,635 SF); marginal CS-MU-V-CO overlap at boundary (0.5%, 764 SF)
- DB90 entitles up to **90 ft height** (60 ft by right + 30 ft bonus with affordability commitment)
- DB90 site is not required to comply with base zoning for area, FAR, building coverage, minimum side yard setbacks, and minimum front yard setbacks
- Affordability requirement: 12% of units at 80% MFI (ownership) or 60% MFI (rental), or 10% at 50% MFI
- Maximum impervious cover: 95% per CS-V base
- Non-residential use may not be located above a residential use and may not be on or above the third story

**Tract 2 -- CS-V-CO** (General Commercial Services -- Vertical Mixed Use -- Conditional Overlay)
- Coverage: 95.5% of parcel (67,003 SF); marginal SF-3 overlap on western edge (3.3%, 2,308 SF)
- **75-foot building setback along western property line** (per CO, depicted in Exhibit D of Zoning Ordinance)
- Maximum Building Height: 60 feet
- Minimum Street Side Setback: 10 feet
- Minimum Interior Side Setback: 0 feet
- Maximum Building Coverage: 95%
- Maximum Impervious Cover: 95%
- Maximum F.A.R.: 2:1
- Prohibited higher-intensity commercial uses per CO

**Tract 3 -- CS-V-CO** (same as Tract 2)
- Coverage: 96% of parcel (6,888 SF); marginal CS-V-DB90 overlap at shared boundary (4%, 289 SF)
- Same CO conditions as Tract 2

### Rezoning Ordinance [COA GIS]

Ordinance **20250925-083**, approved September 11, 2025, Case C14-2024-0163. [COA GIS, Amanda/Geocortex]

Prior ordinances on record: 20081016-049, 20051215-084, 19990225-070b, 781019-E. [COA GIS]

### Residential Compatibility Standards [COA GIS]

**SF-3 zoning confirmed adjacent to the west** (parcel 0100050259, PID 100272). [COA GIS]

> **Correction vs. client intake:** The intake references SF-5 triggering compatibility. GIS confirms **SF-3**, not SF-5. Both trigger identical compatibility standards under LDC 25-2-1063 et seq., so the regulatory impact is the same, but the zoning designation is more precisely SF-3. [COA GIS]

Compatibility standards require:
- 25-foot Compatibility Buffer (10-ft Screening Zone + 15-ft Restricted Zone)
- Height step-downs near the SF-3 boundary (25 ft within 50 ft, stepping up)
- Exterior lighting hooded/shielded so not visible from triggering property line
- Refuse slab minimum 15 ft from triggering property
- Screening of vehicle lights, mechanical equipment, outdoor storage, refuse, and common amenity areas

The **75-ft CO setback** on the western boundary of Tracts 2 & 3 exceeds and subsumes the standard compatibility setback requirements for those parcels.

### Critical Massing Constraint

> **DB90 applies ONLY to Tract 1 (3.44 ac), NOT to Tracts 2 & 3 (1.77 ac combined).** The development's massing strategy must concentrate height on the Tract 1 footprint. Tracts 2 & 3 are capped at 60 ft under CS base zoning, further constrained by the 75-ft CO setback and compatibility step-downs from the western SF-3 boundary. [COA GIS]

### TCAD Data Lag

> TCAD still reports **SF-3** zoning for Tract 3 (1401 Collier St). COA GIS confirms **CS-V-CO** per Ordinance 20250925-083. This is a TCAD data lag, not a substantive problem. GIS is authoritative for zoning. [TCAD, COA GIS]

## 5. Mixed Use Design Standards (Subchapter E)

> **Severity:** 🟡 MODERATE CONSTRAINT -- AEC likely required for internal circulation

The site is subject to **LDC Subchapter E, Article 4 Mixed Use Design Standards** because it fronts a Core Transit Corridor (S Lamar Blvd) and the aggregate site exceeds 5 acres. [COA GIS]

### Core Transit Corridor Frontage (S Lamar Blvd)

| Standard | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Minimum sidewalk width | 15 ft (Planting Zone + Clear Zone) |
| Planting Zone | 8 ft minimum adjacent to curb; street trees at 30 ft o.c. |
| Clear Zone | 7 ft minimum hardscape; unobstructed path 8 ft min height |
| Utilities | Underground required |
| Building placement | 75% min of net frontage built to Clear Zone (or Supplemental Zone) |
| Off-street parking | Prohibited between Core Transit Corridor and street-facing facade |
| Building entryways | Spaced at no more than 75 ft along S Lamar elevation |

### Internal Circulation Route (Sites 5 Acres and Larger)

- **Alternative Equivalent Compliance (AEC) may be necessary** because the total site exceeds 5 acres but full access from Internal Circulation Routes to S Lamar Blvd is prohibited.
- Future ROW dedication may result in net site area below 5 acres, potentially removing this trigger.
- Internal blocks: no larger than 5 acres; maximum block face 800 ft.
- Project Circulation Plan required.

### Additional Standards

- Private common open space: 5% of gross site area
- Shaded sidewalk: alongside minimum 50% of Roadway/ICR frontage
- Connectivity: private drive or public street connections to existing drives/streets; minimum 2 additional connectivity measures
- Screening of rooftop mechanical equipment required from far side of adjacent streets

> **Where PD goes deeper:** PD's memo includes detailed analysis of building orientation requirements relative to ICR, Supplemental Zone allowances (up to 30% of linear frontage at 30 ft wide), and shade/shelter standards. Our automated system identifies Subchapter E applicability and core requirements but does not yet model the full design standard matrix.

> **Where our system adds value:** Automated confirmation that no conflicting overlays (ETOD, TOD, Downtown, West Campus) apply, verified across all 168 GIS layers.

> **Severity:** 🔴 SIGNIFICANT CONSTRAINT

**Grantor:** Vail Corporation (Texas limited partnership)
**Beneficiary:** City of Austin
**Case:** C14-78-155

**Property burdened:** Portions of Lots 3 and 4, Wendlandt's Subdivision (42,000 SF per Vol 1061, Pg 293) -- this directly burdens the western edge of what is now Tract 2. [County Clerk]

**ROW Dedication Analysis:**

The ASMP requires 116 ft ROW. PD's memo notes that per City staff, the full 116-ft ASMP width may not be necessary, but the AMATP 2025 minimum cross-section of 100 ft is required. With existing ROW of 88 ft at the site frontage, the associated dedication is approximately **7 ft** measured from the existing centerline of S Lamar Blvd. The developer will be responsible for back-of-curb improvements: 8-ft landscape, 7-ft bike lane, 2-ft buffer, and 7-ft sidewalk.

> **Where our system adds precision:** We captured both the ASMP required ROW (116 ft) and the actual existing ROW range (77--157 ft, mean ~100 ft) from GIS, plus the full TxDOT roadway characteristics. The 37,215 AADT figure is the 2024 count directly from TxDOT, confirming the high-traffic frontage.
